title: O Zion, Tune Thy Voice
description: O Zion, Tune Thy Voice in Tonic Solfa to BELSIZE, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Philip Doddridge wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 319 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Glory of the Church in the Latter Day. Is. 60:1”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Hallelujah Metre (6.6.6.6.4.4.4.4), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to BELSIZE; any other Hallelujah Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O Zi-on, tune thy voice, And raise thy hands on high; Tell all the earth thy joys, And boast sal-va-tion nigh. Cheer-ful in God, A-rise and shine, While rays di-vine Stream all a-broad.

lines: And raise thy hands on high;
Tell all the earth thy joys,

licence: Public domain: Philip Doddridge died in 1751.
credits: Words by Philip Doddridge (1702–1751), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to BELSIZE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
